title: Global decay in a cubic unit-delay equation with a time-dependent coefficient
source_title: Jelentés a 2011. évi Schweitzer Miklós Matematikai Emlékversenyről

difficulty_reason: The first proof compares moving maxima on four-step windows to force a divergent damping product despite arbitrarily small instantaneous damping. The second builds a delay-integral Lyapunov function and uses uniformly separated intervals of positive mass to force a divergent loss.
